neighbours.label: The inverted ' is' after a fronted negative or question phrase (Not only is it, In what way is, In no place is); plain ' is' in the same content stays quiet
fire: The storm was terrible indeed. Not only is it the largest on record.
In what sense is this film a story about grief?
Nowhere is the fault line more clearly visible.
It was a great success. Not only is the hall full every night.
In what way is the sequel better than the original?
In no case is the buyer required to pay twice.
Never is the valley more lovely than in May.
Rarely is a debut novel so confident and so funny.
quiet: The storm was terrible and it is the largest on record.
This film is a story about grief and loss.
The fault line is clearly visible near the road.
It was a great success and the hall is full every night.
The sequel is better than the original in every way.
The buyer is not required to pay twice in any case.
The valley is lovely in May and very green.
A debut novel is often confident and sometimes funny.

short: inverted is after a fronted phrase
